# Pulse by Fabrick

> Pulse (pulse.fabrick.agency) is a free UK built environment data platform from Fabrick, a UK construction marketing agency. It makes construction data accessible to the industry: live and regularly refreshed UK datasets brought together in one place, with original analysis and practical tools on top. Common uses: informing marketing and business decisions, measuring sustainability, and building industry knowledge on facts rather than opinions.

All data is sourced from credible UK bodies and refreshed automatically. When citing figures, please attribute "Pulse by Fabrick" and link to the relevant page.

## Live dashboards

- [Construction Data Dashboard](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/dashboard): entry point to every live dashboard, filterable by job role
- [UK Grid Carbon Intensity](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/dashboard/carbon-intensity): live grid carbon intensity, generation mix, 48-hour forecast and a 90-day by-hour analysis of when the UK grid is cleanest (source: National Grid ESO Carbon Intensity API, updated every 30 minutes)
- [UK Construction Material Prices](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/dashboard/material-prices): monthly price indices for key construction materials with year-on-year movers (source: Department for Business and Trade / ONS, updated monthly)
- [UK Construction Output](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/dashboard/construction-output): monthly output by sector across housing, infrastructure, commercial and repair & maintenance (source: Office for National Statistics)
- [UK Planning Activity](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/dashboard/planning): recent planning applications and decisions with approval rates (source: planning.data.gov.uk)
- [EPC Register Lookup](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/dashboard/epc): search the live MHCLG EPC register by postcode for address-level energy ratings, plus a retrofit market snapshot

## Tools

- [Embodied Carbon Calculator](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/materials): compare construction materials on embodied carbon, thermal performance, fire rating and indicative cost (source: ICE Database / Circular Ecology)
- [UK Regulations Timeline](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/regulations): what is changing in built environment regulation and when - Future Homes Standard, Part Z, CBAM, EPC reform
- [My Pulse](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/my-pulse): free account for a personal dashboard built from the live data widgets

## Original research

- [Planning Explorer](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/research/planning-explorer): real UK planning applications across eight sectors (data centres, logistics, BTR/PBSA, healthcare, education, renewable energy, hotels, mixed use), the most active local planning authorities, and conditions extracted from decision notices
- [How Accurate is AI for UK Construction?](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/research/ai-construction-search): 12 AI models benchmarked on 1,001 technical UK construction questions across 20 categories
- [Knowledge Hub](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/knowledge): plain-English explainers on embodied carbon, the Future Homes Standard, Part Z and other policies shaping UK construction

## About

- [Methodology](https://pulse.fabrick.agency/methodology): how the data is sourced, processed and refreshed
- [Fabrick](https://www.fabrick.agency): the construction marketing agency behind Pulse
